facts.fact: On 24 February 2026 the digital-transformation steering unit met at the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Public Portfolio with ACSI and the PDRCL project team, which ACSI runs.
The PDRCL was demonstrated in detail on 24 February 2026 and ACSI was said to be preparing its imminent deployment; nothing is stated as live.
